questions.question: What is the best-selling video game of all time with over 300 million copies sold?
questions.explanation: Mojang's sandbox phenomenon Minecraft has sold over 300 million units across all platforms worldwide.
questions.funFact: Markus 'Notch' Persson created the first playable version of Minecraft in just a single weekend in May 2009!

questions.question: In the anime 'Dragon Ball Z', what iconic power level number does Vegeta famously scream over his scouter?
questions.explanation: In the famous English dub, Vegeta crushes his scouter and yells 'It's over 9,000!' when measuring Goku's raw power.
questions.funFact: In the original Japanese manga and anime, Vegeta actually said 'Over 8,000!' (Hassen) - the English voice actors altered it for lip sync!

questions.question: In which game did Mario make his first appearance in 1981?
questions.explanation: Mario debuted as 'Jumpman' in the arcade game Donkey Kong, designed by Shigeru Miyamoto.
questions.funFact: He was originally a carpenter, not a plumber.

questions.question: What is the name of the red ghost in Pac-Man?
questions.explanation: The four original ghosts are Blinky (red), Pinky (pink), Inky (cyan) and Clyde (orange).
questions.funFact: Pac-Man's creator said the character was inspired by a pizza with a slice missing.

questions.question: Which company created Sonic the Hedgehog, first released in 1991?
questions.explanation: Sega created Sonic as a mascot to compete with Nintendo's Mario.
questions.funFact: Sonic's best friend Tails has the real name Miles Prower, a pun on 'miles per hour'.

questions.question: How many Pokemon were there in the original Generation 1?
questions.explanation: The original Red and Blue games featured 151 Pokemon, from Bulbasaur (#1) to Mew (#151).
questions.funFact: Mew was secretly added to the game late in development.

questions.question: Which company developed Fortnite?
questions.explanation: Epic Games released Fortnite in 2017, and its free Battle Royale mode became a global phenomenon.
questions.funFact: Fortnite Battle Royale was reportedly built in about two months.

questions.question: Which Soviet engineer created Tetris in 1984?
questions.explanation: Alexey Pajitnov created Tetris while working at a computing centre in Moscow.
questions.funFact: The name mixes 'tetra' (four blocks) and 'tennis', Pajitnov's favourite sport.

questions.question: The original PlayStation was born from a failed partnership between Sony and which company?
questions.explanation: Sony and Nintendo had planned a CD add-on for the SNES, but the deal collapsed, so Sony built its own console.
questions.funFact: The first PlayStation launched in Japan in December 1994.

questions.question: Before making video games, Nintendo was founded in 1889 as a company making what?
questions.explanation: Fusajiro Yamauchi founded Nintendo to make hanafuda, traditional Japanese playing cards.
questions.funFact: Nintendo roughly means 'leave luck to heaven'.

questions.question: In Minecraft, which dimension do you reach through an obsidian portal?
questions.explanation: Players build an obsidian portal and light it with flint and steel to enter the fiery Nether.
questions.funFact: The Nether is full of lava, and its portals are purple.

questions.question: How quickly did Grand Theft Auto V reach $1 billion in sales after its 2013 launch?
questions.explanation: GTA V made about $800 million on its first day and $1 billion within three days.
questions.funFact: It was among the most profitable entertainment products ever.

questions.question: Who is the main protagonist of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt?
questions.explanation: Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter known as the White Wolf, is the lead of CD Projekt Red's game.
questions.funFact: The games are based on books by Polish author Andrzej Sapkowski.

questions.question: Which game, hugely popular in 2020, features Crewmates and Impostors on a spaceship?
questions.explanation: Among Us was made by the small studio Innersloth and blew up during 2020 thanks to streamers.
questions.funFact: It was actually released in 2018 and became popular two years later.

questions.question: Which mobile battle royale game was banned in India in September 2020?
questions.explanation: India banned PUBG Mobile and dozens of other apps in 2020, and Krafton later launched BGMI for the Indian market.
questions.funFact: BGMI stands for Battlegrounds Mobile India.

questions.question: Which studio developed Elden Ring, which was released in 2022?
questions.explanation: FromSoftware created Elden Ring, with worldbuilding help from fantasy author George R. R. Martin.
questions.funFact: It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2022.

questions.question: Who is the AI antagonist in Valve's puzzle game Portal?
questions.explanation: GLaDOS runs the Aperture Science lab and taunts the player with dark humour.
questions.funFact: The phrase 'The cake is a lie' became a huge internet meme.

questions.question: Kratos, the hero of God of War, originally comes from which mythology?
questions.explanation: The series began in Greek mythology and moved to Norse mythology in the 2018 game.
questions.funFact: In the 2018 game, Kratos is a father to a son named Atreus.

questions.question: Which 1993 game by id Software helped define the first-person shooter genre?
questions.explanation: Doom popularised fast 3D shooting and online multiplayer, and inspired countless modders.
questions.funFact: Doom has been ported to almost every device, even calculators.

questions.question: In what year did the Nintendo Switch release?
questions.explanation: The hybrid console launched in March 2017 with The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild.
questions.funFact: It became one of the best-selling consoles of all time.

questions.question: The Dota 2 championship 'The International' 2021 had a prize pool of over how much?
questions.explanation: The International 2021 broke esports records with a prize pool of over $40 million, funded largely by fans.
questions.funFact: The first International in 2011 had a $1.6 million prize pool.

questions.question: Pokemon GO, which took the world by storm in 2016, was developed by which company?
questions.explanation: Niantic built Pokemon GO using augmented reality and real-world maps.
questions.funFact: It reached 500 million downloads in less than a year.

questions.question: The Angry Birds game franchise was created by a company from which country?
questions.explanation: Rovio Entertainment, based in Finland, released Angry Birds in 2009.
questions.funFact: Rovio had reportedly made dozens of games before Angry Birds became a hit.

questions.question: Why did creator Dong Nguyen pull the hit mobile game Flappy Bird in 2014?
options: He felt it was too addictive
questions.explanation: Nguyen removed the game because he felt it was too addictive, even though it was reportedly making about $50,000 a day.
questions.funFact: The game was created in just a few days.

questions.question: Which Atari game released in 1972 helped start the video game industry?
questions.explanation: Pong, a simple table tennis game, was an early arcade hit.
questions.funFact: Pong began as a training exercise for an engineer.

questions.question: Which company operates the Steam gaming platform?
questions.explanation: Valve, led by Gabe Newell, launched Steam in 2003, and it became the largest PC game store.
questions.funFact: Valve created Half-Life, Portal and Counter-Strike.

questions.question: In The Last of Us, which fungus causes the pandemic?
questions.explanation: The game's infection is based on real Cordyceps fungi, which infect insects.
questions.funFact: HBO adapted the game into a hit TV series in 2023.

questions.question: What is the name of Naruto's home village?
questions.explanation: Naruto Uzumaki comes from Konohagakure, the Village Hidden in the Leaves.
questions.funFact: Naruto's dream is to become Hokage, the leader of the village.

questions.question: What is Monkey D. Luffy's Devil Fruit power in One Piece?
questions.explanation: Luffy ate the Gomu Gomu no Mi, which turns his body into rubber.
questions.funFact: Devil Fruit users can't swim, so Luffy sinks in water.

questions.question: Who created the manga and anime Attack on Titan?
questions.explanation: Hajime Isayama wrote and drew Attack on Titan, which ran from 2009 to 2021.
questions.funFact: Isayama has said an unpleasant encounter with a customer at his part-time job inspired the idea of the Titans.

questions.question: What food does the Shinigami Ryuk love in Death Note?
questions.explanation: Ryuk is often seen eating apples, which he says are irresistible to Shinigami because they don't have them in their world.
questions.funFact: Ryuk was bored in the Shinigami realm, so he dropped his Death Note in the human world.

questions.question: Which Studio Ghibli film won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2003?
questions.explanation: Hayao Miyazaki's Spirited Away won the Academy Award in 2003.
questions.funFact: It was the first hand-drawn, non-English film to win the award.

questions.question: Demon Slayer: Mugen Train (2020) broke which record?
questions.explanation: Mugen Train surpassed Spirited Away to become Japan's highest-grossing film.
questions.funFact: It earned about half a billion dollars worldwide.

questions.question: What was the significant achievement of Ash Ketchum in the Pokemon anime in 2022?
options: He became Pokemon Master of Kanto
questions.explanation: After more than 25 years, Ash won the Pokemon World Coronation Series and became World Champion.
questions.funFact: Ash stayed 10 years old for over 25 years.

questions.question: What is Goku's Saiyan birth name in Dragon Ball?
questions.explanation: Goku was born as Kakarot on planet Vegeta and sent to Earth as a baby.
questions.funFact: His father was Bardock.

questions.question: In Jujutsu Kaisen, which cursed spirit is called the 'King of Curses'?
questions.explanation: Sukuna's finger is swallowed by Yuji Itadori, letting the curse live inside him.
questions.funFact: Sukuna's cursed fingers must be collected in the story.

questions.question: In My Hero Academia, who passes the power 'One For All' to Izuku Midoriya?
questions.explanation: All Might, the Symbol of Peace, passes One For All to Izuku after seeing his heroic spirit.
questions.funFact: Izuku was originally born without a Quirk.

questions.question: In Fullmetal Alchemist, which principle governs alchemy?
questions.explanation: To gain something, something of equal value must be lost.
questions.funFact: The Elric brothers break this rule in their attempt to bring back their mother.

questions.question: What is Doraemon's favourite food?
questions.explanation: Doraemon, the robot cat from the future, loves dorayaki, a sweet red-bean pancake sandwich.
questions.funFact: Doraemon is very popular in India.

questions.question: Who is known as the 'God of Manga' and created Astro Boy?
questions.explanation: Osamu Tezuka's Astro Boy shaped the style of Japanese manga and anime.
questions.funFact: Tezuka created over 150,000 pages of manga in his lifetime.

questions.question: In Spy x Family, what secret ability does Anya Forger have?
questions.explanation: Anya is a telepath, which she keeps secret from her spy father Loid and assassin mother Yor.
questions.funFact: Her love of peanuts became a beloved trait.

questions.question: In One Punch Man, how does hero Saitama defeat his enemies?
questions.explanation: Saitama trained so hard that he can defeat any enemy with a single punch, leaving him bored.
questions.funFact: He lost all his hair from his training.

questions.question: What is the in-game username of the hero of Sword Art Online?
questions.explanation: Kazuto Kirigaya plays as Kirito in the deadly virtual reality game of SAO.
questions.funFact: Players in the game can't log out until it's beaten.

questions.question: Which Evangelion character pilots Eva Unit-01?
questions.explanation: Shinji Ikari is a reluctant teenage pilot forced by his father into fighting Angels.
questions.funFact: The show became famous for its psychological themes.

questions.question: Which Pokemon is number 25 in the Pokedex?
questions.explanation: Pikachu is #25 in the National Pokedex and the mascot of the franchise.
questions.funFact: Pikachu was almost not the mascot; Clefairy was considered.

questions.question: Which Xbox franchise stars the super soldier Master Chief?
questions.explanation: Halo: Combat Evolved was a launch title for the original Xbox in 2001, starring the Spartan Master Chief.
questions.funFact: Master Chief's real name is John-117.

questions.question: In Hunter x Hunter, who is Gon Freecss searching for?
questions.explanation: Gon becomes a Hunter to find his father Ging, a legendary Hunter.
questions.funFact: Gon was raised by his aunt Mito on Whale Island.

questions.question: In Chainsaw Man, which devil does Denji merge with to gain his powers?
questions.explanation: Denji becomes Chainsaw Man after merging with his devil friend Pochita, the Chainsaw Devil.
questions.funFact: Denji's dream is very simple: to live a normal life.

questions.question: Which mob in Minecraft is said to have come about by accident, when the creator made a mistake making a pig model?
questions.explanation: Notch reportedly mixed up the dimensions of a pig model, which resulted in the tall, green Creeper.
questions.funFact: Creepers explode near players.

questions.question: Which game franchise is known for the creed 'Nothing is true, everything is permitted'?
questions.explanation: The phrase is the core motto of the Assassin's Creed series, and the Assassins Brotherhood.
questions.funFact: The first Assassin's Creed game came out in 2007.
